description: This is a unit test class for the ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl class, which tests immutability, equality, null handling, proper command creation, and other behaviors of the command implementation within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for Verify behavior of ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures with a ModifyThing and its corresponding command object.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl instances are immutable and that the Thing class is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies equals and hashCode implementations using EqualsVerifier, ignoring specific fields.

methods.name: tryToGetModifyThingLiveCommandForNull
methods.description: Checks that passing null to the factory method throws NullPointerException with expected message.

methods.name: tryToGetModifyThingLiveCommandForCreateThingCommand
methods.description: Checks that passing an incompatible command mock throws ClassCastException.

methods.name: getModifyThingLiveCommandReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the constructed command correctly copies fields from the twin command object.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that setDittoHeaders method returns a new command with specified headers.

methods.name: answerReturnsNotNull
methods.description: Checks that the answer() method on the command returns a non-null value.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that the toString method output contains class name and command details.
